basis: Defining skeletal myopathy, joint contractures and external ophthalmoplegia; respiratory distress and dysphagia are not established as common.
Anterior pituitary neoplasm; visual pathway compression occurs mainly with larger tumours and is not established in >=30% across the umbrella.
Idiopathic diffuse alveolar/interstitial injury with respiratory failure; reported hypertension does not establish direct vascular injury.
Immune-mediated lymphohistiocytic panniculitis affects subcutis; systemic hemophagocytic disease and coagulopathy are variable, not established in >=30%.
Systemic treponemal infection; characteristic rash and mucous patches are generally transient without lasting skin or oral damage.
Defining skin aplasia and epibulbar dermoids; CNS malformations 80-99%, hearing loss 30-79%; renal, airway, cardiac, gut and skeletal anomalies omitted by cap.
Structural defect of the retinal macula.
Multiple enchondromas and osteochondromas define skeletal disease; supplied HPO reports cranial nerve paralysis in 80-99%, supporting neurologic involvement.
Clonal myeloid blast proliferation in marrow and blood; extramedullary tissue involvement is uncommon.
Hair-follicle inflammation; most cases are infectious, usually bacterial, although the umbrella includes noninfectious forms.
Core developmental disability with distal digit and nail hypoplasia; supplied cardiac findings lack a frequency establishing >=30%.
Hereditary Wilms tumour subtype; nephroblastoma originates in the kidney.
Developmental brain disease and macrothrombocytopenia define it; hearing loss/camptodactyly 2/2, scoliosis 30-79%; cardiac/endocrine anomalies omitted by cap.
Defining immune, gut and endocrine disease; mucocutaneous candidiasis 80-99% and eczema 30-79% support skin; bronchiectasis, bladder, bone and vascular findings exceed cap.
Specific neurodevelopmental learning disorder affecting numerical processing.
Spinocerebellar neurodegeneration; slow eye movements reflect neurologic oculomotor dysfunction rather than intrinsic eye damage.
Benign neoplasm arising in the abdominal peritoneum.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay define disease; fifth-finger joint contractures affect 5/9 (~56%); isolated cardiac and other findings do not establish >=30%.
Malignancy of the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; HPV association does not make the tumour an infection.
Dysplastic glandular neoplasm originating in rectal mucosa.
Parasitic cyst disease predominantly occupying liver; hepatic cysts reported in 80-99%; pulmonary cysts occur in 5-29%, below threshold.
Ovarian epithelial malignancy affects a reproductive organ; no defining endocrine dysfunction or common direct damage to an axis is established.
Aspiration directly injures lung tissue; the supplied definition includes chemical pneumonitis, so infection is not intrinsic across this concept.
MYO15A-related nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss.
Inflammation confined to tendon-surrounding paratenon; inflammation alone does not establish autoimmune or infectious disease.
